V-space tone curve is a power law with per-pair gamma 3.2-3.6 (pair0 3.19-3.27, pair1 3.44-3.58, pair2 3.31-3.49, pair3 3.44-4.58, pair4 3.47-3.72) matching HSV sev5 gamma=3.5; HSV S ratio 1.009-1.020 rules out saturate_weaken and RGB-gamma (RGB gamma would raise S ~2x; gamma_RGB:5 test=24.90dB CI 0/10 vs HSV 30.43dB); mean_shift -44..-76; clipping matches (zero-frac delta 0.7pp at sev5 vs 3.8pp at sev4)
